meta.pressure: gauge (linear, deviations from the static point)
meta.units: SI: m, m/s, Pa, N, m^3/s, s

A_k_oil.note: k_oil = beta A^2 / V; head: V = A_A (L0 + e); rod side (only if the trapped rod chamber is pressurised; at 2 bar g it cavitates after about 0.1 mm of push-in, spec 3.2): V = A_B (stroke - e + L0). L0 = 0 at e = 0 is clipped at 1 mm.

dc_gain.note: q -> s, xM is an integrator (velocity A^-1 per m^3/s); q -> p_A steady value = c_h / A_A^2 (dashpot pressure while moving)
q -> s, xM is an integrator (velocity A^-1 per m^3/s); q -> p_A steady value = c_h / A_A^2 (dashpot pressure while moving)

C_leg_element.description: per-leg hydraulic element for multi-leg linear models (locked or moving)
inputs: u_v: section velocity command after the ramp [m/s] (q = A_A u_v)
s_dot: piston velocity relative to the barrel [m/s]
outputs: F: actuator force on the rod chain [N] = A_A p_A - c_h s_dot
C_leg_element.equations: dp_A/dt = beta/V_A(e) (A_A u_v - A_A s_dot);  F = A_A p_A - c_h s_dot
C_leg_element.equivalent: F = k_oil(e) (s_ref - s) + c_h (s_ref_dot - s_dot) with s_ref = int u_v dt, k_oil(e) = beta A_A / (L0 + e)  (identical to the L2 force law of dynamics_model.md 2.3)
C_leg_element.ramp: u_v = rate_limit(u, v_max / T_ramp) (nonlinear; T_ramp 0.1 s, rate 0.2267 m/s^2)
C_leg_element.c_h: c_h = c_ax_YAML (1 + k_oil/k_g)^2 when the dashpot sits across the oil only (spec 3.5)

D_lag_map.note: semi-implicit Euler with the actuator force from a post-step hook. lag0 = force from the state at the end of the previous step (textbook symplectic Euler); lag1 = the pychrono hook delay of dynamics_model.md 4.6 (force set after step n acts in step n+2); lag1_pred = force evaluated at x + h v (spec 5.3). zeta_* = discrete-map damping of the physical pair; dzeta = numerical damping (negative = energy added).
